sources.label: FHWA stochastic breakdown probability / product-limit method
sources.basis: FHWA describes freeway capacity as stochastic, classifies the interval immediately before breakdown as an uncensored capacity observation, treats free-flow intervals not followed by breakdown as censored observations, and estimates breakdown probability with the product-limit method.

sources.label: FHWA decision-parameter chapter
sources.basis: FHWA describes using current speed/flow conditions to estimate the probability of breakdown in the next interval and identifies the product-limit method as an established technique.
